integrity.known_prior_scalar_result: The equality \(g(\operatorname{Cr}_n)=2\) is prior work and is not claimed as novel.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to ordinary crown graphs \(K_{n,n}-M_n\) with \(n\ge3\) and to ordinary geodetic sets.
The accessible full text of the 2024 crown paper covers the scalar geodetic number and edge-removal stability, not an all-set polynomial.

The 2013 geodetic-polynomial introduction page was accessible only at abstract/bibliographic level, and two cited 2021 conference proceedings on special-graph geodetic numbers were not located in accessible full text.

The `first_public_date` records the exact-day public date verified for the foundational geodetic-number source; a direct geodetic-polynomial source is publicly visible from May 2012 but only at month precision in the accessible copy.
title: Geodetic polynomial and minimal geodetic sets of crown graphs
